name: real_normal_adapt_v2_test
label: Exploratory. Real test was viewed in real_event_eval_v1 and earlier rounds; this is the only further Real test access for the v2 adaptation line.

arms.GBT_D3: artifacts/real_normal_adapt_v2_dev_20261106/gbt_D3.pkl on Real input aligned with affine_alignment.json (fit on adapt_normal only)

reference: M0@0.70 and ENS@0.75 rows from real_event_eval_v1 per_case.csv (no rerun)
onset: 0.75 for both arms, fixed a priori (same value as ENS); no tuning on calibrate or test
event_policy_fixed: clear 0.4, k_on 3, k_off 3, min_event 0.5 s, merge 0.5 s, every frame with full valid 150-frame history
population_and_metrics: identical to real_event_eval_v1 (test_normal 33, test_fault 392 minus 7 quarantined, supplemental 25 separate; normal case false-alarm rate, events/h, occupancy; fault new-confirmation recall at/after onset, pre-onset spans, latency; window FPR/recall at 0.5)
key_question: Does target-normal GBT keep Real fault detection, or does it call all Real data normal?
reading_rule: Report as is. Fault recall far below M0@0.70 (e.g. new-confirmation recall under 50%) is read as the adaptation learning domain rather than fault; no rescue by retuning on Real test.
forbidden: changing arms, onset or policy after Real test access
